title: Fix ChatMessageEntry.mentionScopes: should be String[] not has_mention_all bool
description: Spec (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-push-00) defines ChatMessageEntry.mentionScopes as String[] containing scope values like everyone, here, admins. The monorepo has has_mention_all: bool which loses which scopes are targeted. This matters for per-scope urgency override logic in push spec. Replace has_mention_all with mentionScopes: Vec<String>.
